findings.passage: "For us it's do or die, because Gov. Abbott is going to call another special session as early as Aug. 9," Reynolds said. "We hope the Senate realizes that we're on borrowed time, so we really need federal intervention."
findings.note: HuffPost (via Yahoo) quotes him in Washington during the 2021 quorum break, speaking about the Texas voting bill under consideration and asking for federal voting-rights legislation. It does not mention voter ID or citizenship by name.

findings.passage: "There's so many Black and brown people who will be disenfranchised if we don't get this passed," Reynolds said.
findings.note: Same story. 'This' refers to the federal For the People Act, which the article says would override state voting restrictions. No mention of ID or citizenship.
